cell_level.note: not part of the network: cells, division and selection act on whole string sets
cell_level.division: a cell divides when its number of strings has doubled; its strings are shared equally between the daughters (L/R strings forcibly left/right in model iii)
cell_level.membrane_condition: model iii: a cell cannot divide without a membrane string of 10 M symbols (MMMMMMMMMMEM)
cell_level.population: max 100 cells with max 50 strings; when a new cell is added an old one is removed; cells carry an age counter reset at division (book 11.1.3)
